title: BoA: risk-off stays in place as the dollar leads
summary: The Nov 12 bank note keeps a tactical risk-off stance. The BoA Bull & Bear Indicator is at 7.4, up from 7.2, with the equity-flow component at the 96th percentile (very bullish) and fund-manager positioning at the 100th percentile (very bullish), while global stock-index breadth is at the 21st percentile (bearish). Weekly global equity fund inflows were $98.3 billion, the largest since June 2026. Year-to-date, US stocks are about +10.9% and the dollar about +4.9%. The November fund manager cash and crowded-trade survey is not yet the basis for the site's Soft ↔ Crowded fund-manager panel, which is still the August 2026 survey.

title: Goldman: hedge funds sold the rip, tech long/short at a record low
summary: Goldman's latest prime-services data show professional managers covering index hedges while continuing to sell individual stocks, and pushing technology long/short exposure to the lowest level in the bank's records, even as the index rally made the selling look mistimed.
